text:
sophia: brain-dump: what if edge sidecars act as "local deciders" and can propose fallbacks, but only after doing a small quorum check with nearby peers?
ben: local quorum reduces noisy single-node flips. how many peers is "small"? 3? 5?
omar: quorum size should be policy-driven per-pool. default 3. also add small randomized backoff to avoid stampedes.
talia: big UX question: how do we present these proposals in the console so SREs can trust provenance?
sophia: proposal: each proposal gets a decision_id and a provenance chain: nodeA->nodeB votes->propose. Console shows compact provenance line and a "drill into votes" view.
ben: we must differentiate shadow/metrics-only mode vs live apply. add badge: "shadow" so operators don't mistake telemetry for real actions.
omar: arbitration: central arbiter still has final say. local proposal becomes "candidate" and arbiter responds with accept/reject/soft-accept. soft-accept = applied but monitored for X minutes before sticky.
talia: UI: operator inbox card shows candidate badge, quorum size, confidence, and quick actions: accept, defer, override. clicking show -> playback of signal period + votes timeline.
sophia: audit: keep full chain for 120 days by default. include signer cert thumbprint, node id, and sample of the pre-decision request flow. exportable.
ben: edge-case: network partition leads to competing candidates. arbiter should prefer proposals with higher quorum and later timestamps, but we should surface conflicts explicitly: "competing candidate on pool-3".
omar: security: sidecars use mTLS and short-lived signer tokens; token id included in audit. ops-bot: infra note - index decision_id in trace-db and link to replay infra.
talia: microcopy: use "candidate" vs "applied" vs "reverted" states. keep language consistent across inbox, timelines, and alerts.
sophia: action items: 1) runtime: quorum handshake + decision_id (owner: sophia, due Fri) 2) platform: arbiter soft-accept flow + audit schema (owner: omar, due next Wed) 3) ux: inbox card + votes timeline mock (owner: ben, due Tue) 4) security: token/cert logging (owner: talia)
ops-bot: NOTE: created ticket INFRA-1400 for local-decider pilot.
sophia: agreed to pilot in one non-prod pool in shadow mode first. will write RFC this week. Thanks!
